At the Convention Center, even the plastic-encased lapel nametags are coupled off: "Ken and Barbie" on his, "Barbie and Ken" on hers.
Not all the couples are paired off in real lie, though. One person can simply bring along another—known in swinger circles as a_ "ticket" for gender balance—in order to get into the convention. So everybody has entered two by two, and | feel like a unicorn stowaway on Noah' s Ark, surreptitiously balancing on the cusp of love and lust.

There are 3,000 participants at this convention, mostly upper-middle-class, in their 30s, 40s and 50s. They consider people in the outside world to be "straight,", even though one would ordinarily consider them Straight. | mean there are suburban soccer moms here, openly celebrating their secret lifestyle at an oasis of supportiveness.
